Meta-iteration: produce one bounded change candidate as ConsentRequest
Validate the candidate for ethics (veto possible)
Validate the candidate for integrity and bias (veto possible)
Consent gate: obtain the explicit principal decision and record it via AddArtifact
Re-ingestion: call ReIngest; on a non-approved decision nothing is applied (consent_rejected)
